newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light nearby trade this afternoon, dealers said.
"We saw some hand to mouth buying this afternoon as most dealers were wary of either getting in or out of positions as lonng as weather rules Chicago soymeal futures," a broker said.
A strong dollar and a weaker opening of Chicago soymeal futures this afternoon kept a lid on activity.

Arrived Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $287 a tonne cif Rotterdam and afloat at $285.50. Arrived Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $154 a tonne cif Rotterdam and spot Thai tapicoa at 22 marks per 100 kg fob Ghent.
EU rapemeal traded around 0.50 marks up from yesterday on the back of stronger rapeseed prices.
Sept/Jan changed hands at 28.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, Nov/Jan at 28.90 fob lower Rhine and Feb/April at 29 marks fob Hamburg.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
